entries.en: I told you to change the oil. Told you it was knocking up a storm.
entries.ro: Ți-am zis să schimbi uleiul. Ți-am zis că bate ca dracu'.

entries.en: Yeah, yeah. How much will it cost to fix?
entries.ro: Da, da. Cât costă să repari?

entries.en: Now? Now it'll cost a lot. We have to put in a whole new transmission.
entries.ro: Acum? Acum e scump de tot. Trebuie o transmisie nouă.

entries.en: You don't take care of your ride, better take care of your wallet.
entries.ro: Dacă nu ai grijă de mașină, ai grijă de portofel.
